          How this preview works

          This is the simulated build from the plan: no streaming server, nothing to host. The music is original synthwave generated live in your browser — the safe stand-in for the licensed GTA soundtrack — and the “broadcast” is a shuffled queue that starts the moment you press play.

          This preview · simulated

          Every visitor gets their own shuffle, starting wherever they tune in. Free to run, works as a plain web page.

          The real thing · true live

          Icecast + Liquidsoap on a small VPS: one shared feed, everyone hears the same track at the same second, roughly $5–10/mo.
